services.name: Other Cruise Ships
services.desc: Pickup time is 8:30am at Parking Lot Next to Burger King. As you are in contact with us we will wait for you. Please make sure to have your Mobile Phone on and communicate with us. You will have a chance to swim at waterfalls and at the blacksand beach. This is ground tour which takes 8 to 9 hours, don’t expect to spend hours at the waterfall or the blacksand beach. 25 minutes to 45 minutes are allotted for waterfall and for blacksand beach. We have many other highlights to show

services.name: Helicopter Tours
services.desc: We will fly you over for a day to Island of Kauai. With it’s magnificent nature, preserved and protected views, Kauai has hosted over 200 movies, documentaries, TV series and shows. Come with us for a journey to the beauty and spectacular views from high above in the helicopter flying over the Napali Coast which can only be scene from helicopter. Napali Helicopter Tour is number 1 rated helicopter tour in the world. Starting point for this tour is at the Daniel K. Inouye International Airport. If you need a pickup from Waikiki hotels, we have an option for pickup service. All detailed information will be provided to you as soon as the reservation has been

blurb: Guests join guided day trips exploring scenic and cultural highlights of Hawaiian Islands such as Maui's Road to Hana, Kauai's Waimea Canyon, and Big Island's Volcanoes National Park. Tours include transportation, meals on some trips, and stops for swimming and sightseeing. Some tours combine helicopter and ground experiences.
